annotations.title: Check whether a web page changed

description: Did a public web page change? Send a URL (and the content_hash from your last check). Get back the hash of the page's visible text, whether it changed, the title, a short excerpt and when it was fetched. Free. Nothing is stored: keep the hash yourself and send it next time. Public http(s) pages only (ports 80 and 443), text types only, 1.5 MB cap. Limits: Fetches with the user agent 'Countersign/1.0 (checker; LLPRO)'. One GET per call. robots.txt is not read.

previous_hash.description: content_hash from your last check. Leave out on the first check.
